scaling.note: ROOM 42'S DEPTH, FROM THE MAN THE MASTER PAINTED. The composition master drew Thad about 527 tall with his feet at source y 805; the plate is that master at 0.8, cropped from y 150 and drawn at 1.263, so he stands about 532 at y 791. Along Room 5's slope (0.69 per row) that is 497 at the band's far edge and 576 at its near. The barber stands at 493, his soles at y 735 (tools/art/interiors-people.py).

hotspotsNote: Generous over the thing the player sees (ruling 32). THE CHAIR takes in its bucket, which its second LOOK is about. THE JAR is the jar and its shelf. THE BARBER stands left of the chair; a TALK TO on him reaches him.
